result:
I'd send both notifications to both founders. A reply from a lead is high value, so you and Brandon should each get an email the moment it arrives, along with the text of the reply and a link to the lead record. That way whichever of you is free can pick up the phone right away and nobody misses a hot lead.

The signed notification should also go to both of you, since a signed client affects billing, onboarding, and scheduling. If the volume gets annoying later you can add filters in your mail client, but I'd start with everyone in the loop and use a shared alias so nothing gets dropped.
